verses.text: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing in front of the angel of the LORD. Satan was standing at his right side to accuse him.
The LORD said to Satan, "The LORD rebuke you, Satan! The LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn't this man like a burning stick snatched out of the fire?"
Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood in front of the angel.
The angel said to those who were standing in front of him, "Take off his filthy clothes." Then he said to Joshua, "Look, I have taken away your sin, and I will dress you in fine clothes."
Then I said, "Put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and dressed him, while the angel of the LORD stood nearby.
Then the angel of the LORD gave Joshua this solemn command:

"This is what the LORD of Armies says: 'If you walk in my ways and do what I tell you, you will govern my house and be in charge of my courtyards. I will let you come and go among these who are standing here.
"'Listen, Joshua the high priest, you and your companions sitting in front of you. They are a sign of things to come. I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.
Look at the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone. I will carve words on it,' says the LORD of Armies, 'and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.
"'On that day,' says the LORD of Armies, 'each of you will invite your neighbor to sit under your grapevine and fig tree.'"
